title: CurveAMMAdapter has no pause mechanism, leaving no on-chain kill switch during a Curve incident

classification.assetImpact: No on-chain incident response if a Curve pool is compromised. Funds remain accessible to the adapter until the strategy itself is paused/migrated.
classification.likelihood: low - depends on a separate Curve incident

justification: QA recommendation: CurveAMMAdapter should be Pausable for incident response.
